name: Anantara Al Jabal Al Akhdar Resort
positioning: Canyon-edge mountain resort on Oman's Green Mountain, set high in the Al Hajar Mountains
best_for: Couples who want canyon views and private pool villas
Families who want a Kids' Club and outdoor activities in the mountains

facts.text: The resort is set high in the Al Hajar Mountains.
The resort is on the Green Mountain, about two hours' drive inland from Muscat, with dramatic canyon views.
Conde Nast Traveler describes the hotel as sitting on the rim of a canyon in the Al Hajar mountains.
All rooms look out onto the canyon and have balconies.
Rooms have a dressing room and a spa-like bathroom.
Villas come with Villa Host service.
The Anantara Spa offers traditional Thai healing and wellness journeys.
Guests can unwind with spa and hammam rituals.
The resort has temperature-controlled swimming pools and a fitness centre.
Children can enjoy the Kids' Club and outdoor activities.
The resort has five dining venues, including dining overlooking the canyon.
Nearby, guests can explore hiking trails, traditional mountain villages and terraced farms.

highlights.text: Guests can stargaze from the viewing platform where Princess Diana once stood.
Villas have one, two or three bedrooms and a private pool, set in garden surrounds or with an infinity view across the canyon.
Conde Nast Traveler says the hotel has the highest swimming pools, tennis court and stargazing platform in the Middle East.
Signature experiences include sunrise yoga, cliff-edge dining, wellness journeys, stargazing and cultural experiences.
Conde Nast Traveler notes chasm-facing pool villas, majlis-style courtyards and a lantern-lit outdoor hookah space.

considerations.text: Jabal Akhdar is reached through a mountain checkpoint, and a 4WD vehicle is required.
The resort is approximately 2.5 hours by car from Muscat International Airport.
Jabal Akhdar's rose gardens are a draw only during blooming season.
